definitions.explanation: A person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a movie with a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{友達|ともだち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

examples.english: I went over to my friend's house to hang out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、{友達|ともだち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: When I was in elementary school, I played outside with my friends every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧{友達|ともだち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧、⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦ごはん→ごはん：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べている→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I still meet up with friends I made in university from time to time and eat together.

notes:
{友達|ともだち} is the most common word for "friend" in everyday Japanese.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {友達|ともだち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become friends
- {友達|ともだち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to make a friend
- {友達|ともだち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to hang out with friends
- {友達|ともだち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make friends

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: friend (more formal, written style)
- ⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧: close friend, best friend
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: companion, comrade (group context)
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧: acquaintance

USAGE:
{友達|ともだち} already contains ⟦{達|たち}→達：noentry⟧ (plural suffix) but is used for both singular and plural. You can say {友達|ともだち}⟦たち→たち：noentry⟧ for emphasis on multiple friends.
